source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Rub a small amount for only a few seconds even if parts of the hands remain uncovered","B":"Use alcohol hand rub over visibly soiled hands rather than washing them with soap and water","C":"Apply hand rub and immediately wipe the hands dry with a disposable towel before it evaporates","D":"Apply enough product to cover all hand surfaces and rub the hands together until completely dry"}}
source_row.rationale: Correct alcohol-based hand sanitizer technique involves applying enough product to cover all surfaces of the hands and rubbing them together until completely dry (generally taking about 20 seconds), without rinsing or wiping with a towel, which would remove the antimicrobial effect. Visibly soiled hands should be washed with soap and water rather than relying on alcohol-based sanitizer alone.
source_row.source_detail: CDC hand hygiene: apply enough alcohol-based hand rub to cover all surfaces and rub until dry; accessed 2026-08-14.
